sentences.text: Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and having considered the materials  on record, I am of the view that no error, not to speak of any error of law could be  said to have been committed by the Courts below in passing the impugned orders.

costs and that too, on an undertaking given by Mr. Panchal, the learned advocate appearing on  b e h a l f o f t h e p e t i t i o n e r t h a t h e w i l l f u l l y  c o o p e r a t e w i t h t h e t r i a l o f t h e P . F . A . C a s e N o .
I n v i e w o f s u c h  u n d e r t a k i n g g i v e n b y t h e l e a r n e d a d v o c a t e o n b e h a l f o f t h e p e t i t i o n e r ,
t h e o r d e r o f c o s t s i s q u a s h e d . R e s t o f t h e o r d e r r e m a i n s u n d i s t u r b e d .
T h e  C o u r t c o n c e r n e d s h a l l n o w p r o c e e d f u r t h e r w i t h t h e P . F . A . C a s e N o .

taken against the petitioner in accordance with law.
8 With the above, this application is  disposed of.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
9 In  v i e w o f t h e o r d e r p a s s e d i n t h e m a i n m a t t e r , t h e c o n n e c t e d  Miscellaneous Criminal Application is also disposed of.
